## Change

Describe the behavior and why it is needed.

## Test-first evidence

- [ ] Acceptance criterion exists.
- [ ] Failing/regression test was written before implementation.
- [ ] Relevant tests now pass.
- [ ] New schema behavior has migration tests.
- [ ] Security/privacy negative cases are tested where applicable.

## Data and privacy

- [ ] No new personal-data field, or its purpose/retention/sensitivity are documented.
- [ ] No secrets or real-person evidence in fixtures/logs.
- [ ] Regulatory conclusions remain provenance-backed and conservatively worded.

## Schema/API

- [ ] No schema/API change, or migration/OpenAPI/docs have been updated.
